title: Listing Highlight: 108 Mangusta 2002
description: Discover the timeless elegance and power of the 2002 Mangusta 108 Motoryacht, expertly maintained with luxurious upgrades and advanced technology.
html:
Overview of the 2002 Mangusta 108 Motoryacht

The Mangusta 108, is a testament to the quality and craftsmanship of its era. Built in 2002, this motoryacht has been impeccably maintained by a full-time professional crew, ensuring it remains in prime condition. Recent updates include a full engine, generator, and drive service, as well as new exterior soft goods and umbrellas. The yacht has also undergone a complete underwater sand and paint job on the hull and drives, complete with new zincs. Trades are welcome, and owner financing options are available, making this vessel an accessible opportunity for interested buyers.

Powerful MTU Engines and Propulsion Details

At the heart of the Mangusta 108 are twin MTU 4000 M91 engines, each delivering a formidable 2735 horsepower. These engines, with 2510 hours logged, are paired with Kamewa jet drives and ZF transmissions, providing a smooth and efficient propulsion system. The yacht’s engineering ensures a powerful yet stable performance on the water, making it suitable for both leisurely cruises and more demanding voyages.

Luxurious Interior Features and Upgrades

The interior of the Mangusta 108 has been thoughtfully upgraded to enhance comfort and functionality. The galley is equipped with high-end appliances, including a Miele oven, GE stovetop, Whirlpool microwave, and Miele dishwasher. Refrigeration needs are met with multiple Frigit units throughout the yacht, including in the salon, VIP cabin, and master stateroom. Additional amenities such as a Miele washer and dryer, ice-maker, and a JETS vacuum toilet system ensure a convenient and pleasant onboard experience.

Advanced Electronics and Navigation Systems

This yacht is outfitted with cutting-edge electronics and navigation equipment to ensure a seamless journey. Recent upgrades include three Garmin GPS Map 8616 xsv units, a GMR Fantom 54 open array radar, and a Vesper VHF cortex with AIS. Entertainment is enhanced with a Fusion Apollo RA770 Marine system, new speakers, subwoofers, and amplifiers. Connectivity is assured with dual Starlink global satellite internet systems, providing both main and backup access. The yacht also features an 8-channel camera system with DVR and online access for added security and monitoring.

Engine Room Specifications and Maintenance

The engine room of the Mangusta 108 is a hub of efficiency and power. It houses twin MTU 12V4000 engines and twin 33kw Kohler generators, both of which have recently undergone full service. The generators have logged 6981 and 8122 hours, respectively. The yacht is equipped with shore transformers, hot water heaters, and an Idromar watermaker, ensuring all systems are running optimally. Regular maintenance and upgrades have been a priority, contributing to the vessel’s reliability and performance.

Comprehensive Summary and Ownership Options

The 2002 Mangusta 108 Motoryacht offers a well-rounded package of power, comfort, and advanced technology. Its meticulous maintenance and recent upgrades make it a compelling choice for discerning buyers. With options for trade and owner financing, this yacht is accessible to a wider range of potential owners.
